summary: 175-foot Aermotor tower built in 1951 in Alexander State Forest, Rapides Parish, Louisiana; NHLR-registered 1993. No source read gives current staffing or climbing rules.

access.note: The tower sits in the forest's headquarters compound; no source read says whether visitors may climb it.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved height conflict: 175 feet per the NHLR, the Town of Woodworth page and the Forest Lookouts header, versus 176 feet in a Kisatchie National Forest Facebook post seen only as a search snippet (the page returned a login stub; not cited). That snippet also calls it an MC-40 model and 'the tallest active lookout in North America'. No page read names the model, so the facts omit it. The Forest Lookouts page is a header plus one line, so the 1954 camera note rests on that single line. No source read gives current staffing or climbing rules; the Alexander State Forest Wikipedia article and the Louisiana Department of Agriculture and Forestry were not read. Confirm current status before publishing. No corrections to the brief.
